footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to RLJ Lodging Trust: after $25.1M of preferred dividends. The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 1.4% to $1.3B in 2025. Operating income fell 20.9% to $125M, a 9.3% margin.
Net income fell 92.1% to $3.4M, or $0.01 per share. Operating cash flow was $244M and free cash flow $117M, versus $149M; RLJ Lodging Trust returned $120M through dividends and buybacks.
